# Dr. Mogal Prasad Shah — Livestock Development Expert

> Portfolio and knowledge resource for Dr. Mogal Prasad Shah, M.Sc. Animal
> Nutrition, former Director of Nepal's Directorate of Livestock and
> Fisheries Development (DLFD), with 29+ years in livestock development,
> food security, and climate-resilient agriculture in Nepal. Bilingual
> (English/Nepali) content throughout.

## Key pages

- [About](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/about): Biography, education, and career history
- [Expertise & Services](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/services): Consulting service offerings — livestock development, animal health, food security, climate-resilient agriculture
- [Experience](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/experience): Career timeline across institutions
- [Publications](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/publications): Research and publications
- [Farm Tools](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/tools): 12 free bilingual farm calculators (weight estimator, gestation planner, feed rations, dosage checks, vaccination reminders, land-unit converter) — client-side, no data collected
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/knowledge): 32 sourced articles on animal health, cattle/buffalo, goats, poultry, crops, fodder, climate, and farm management — every figure cited (MoALD, DLS, NARC, FAO, Merck Veterinary Manual)
- [Nepal Agriculture Map](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/agromap): Interactive 77-district agricultural data explorer with ecological-belt, crop, livestock and climate layers, district comparison and CSV export
- [Book a Consultation](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/booking): Advisory session booking
- [Contact](https://www.drmogalshah.com.np/contact): Consulting inquiries, office hours, WhatsApp and phone
